_hinweis: Texts on the topic of contracts. vertrag_laeuft_aus: the agent writes (busy, formal), {tage} = days until the contract ends. altstar_karriereende: the player speaks in the conversation (“Gaffer”, formal); the manager replies informally. Placeholders: {spieler}, {spieler_kurz}, {tage}, {berater}.

standard: Good day, {berater} here. {spieler}'s contract runs out in {tage} days. My client would like to know what the club's plans are. There is interest, but we're still waiting to hear from you.
{berater}, {spieler}'s agent. {tage} days left on the contract and no talks so far. We'd like to extend, but we need a signal from you soon.
We want to extend. I'll sit down with you in the next few days.
We'll decide after the next few games. Until then there's no offer.
We're planning without him. The contract runs out.
Very good. I'll hold the other enquiries back for now and await your proposed date.
I'll pass that on. You'll understand that in the meantime we'll also be talking to others.
A shame, but understood. My client will see out his contract and look for a new start.
Gaffer, my contract is running out soon and I'm not getting any younger. I'd like to know whether you're still planning with me for another season.
Gaffer, I feel the years, I'll admit that. Still, I feel good enough for another year. How do you see it?

egoist: Gaffer, I've shown enough over my career. I expect to be made an offer in good time and not left waiting until the last day.
kumpel: Gaffer, the dressing room is my second home. I'd like to add another year, even with fewer appearances. Does that work for you?
heisssporn: Gaffer, everyone is already talking about my farewell, only nobody talks to me. I'm not finished yet. Tell me whether you see it that way too.
vorbildprofi: Gaffer, I don't want to be a burden on the club. If you still need me, I'm happy to stay. If not, I'll stop cleanly and help the youngsters until the last day.
diva: Gaffer, a farewell through the back door is out of the question for me. If it goes on, then with a role that suits my name.
anfuehrer: Gaffer, the youngsters listen to me, and I'd like to use that for another year. Tell me openly whether you see me in the squad for that.

standard: I want you around for another year. We'll talk about a new contract.
There'll be less on the pitch. But in the dressing room I need you, for the youngsters.
The season is your last. We'll give you a proper send-off.
That's what I wanted to hear. Thanks, gaffer. You won't regret it.
I need to think about that. I can't quite imagine it without games yet.
That stings. But fine, now I know and can plan.
